messages:
ashley: Heads-up — planning rollout for payment-service chart v2.14.0 to eu-west at 17:00 UTC. Deploy-bot preflight mostly green but flagged a values mismatch: feature_flags.enable_autoretry differs between prod and canary. Thinking we pin canary values to match prod and run manual verification. Any objections? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: preflight summary:
- schema-check: OK
- images-present: OK
- values-diff: payment-service/values.yaml -> prod vs canary
```yaml
feature_flags:
  enable_autoretry: prod: true
  enable_autoretry: canary: false
```
- change-window: allowed until 18:00 UTC
- auto-rollout-mode: canary-disabled by request

jamal: +1 to holding automatic canary. We saw a small uptick in 5xx on the canary from yesterday's run; not definitive but I'd rather match prod flag for the first manual verification. Also recommend pinning image digest for canary to avoid surprise rebuilds.

kevin: rollback plan ready if needed:
1) helm rollback payment-service <REV> (will revert to last successful revision)
2) if DB schema change suspected -> block and coordinate DB rollback with eng-platform
3) alert on latency increase >10% or error rate >3% triggers immediate rollback

release-ci: I'll prepare a release-notes fragment. Need a 1-line impact blurb and the config diff. Ashley — can you drop the impact sentence? Something like: "Align canary config with prod for autoretry to reduce false-positive regressions during verification."

maria: I'm available to run post-deploy smoke tests in eu-west. If we hold the canary, we can still proceed with the non-config-change parts of the chart (docs, minor templates) in a separate image-only rollout.

ashley: Quick decision: hold the automatic canary rollout. We'll apply a canary-specific override that sets feature_flags.enable_autoretry=true and pins image.digest. Manual canary trigger at 17:30, observation window 30m. release-ci: assemble notes with this snippet and include rollback steps.

deploy-bot: Action created: s3://releases/overrides/2370012345-payment-service-canary-override.yaml
Contents:
```yaml
image:
  tag: "sha256:abc123def456"
feature_flags:
  enable_autoretry: true
```
Helm command for manual canary (run from ci runner):
```
helm upgrade --install payment-service ./charts/payment-service \
  --namespace eu-west \
  --values charts/payment-service/values.yaml \
  --values s3://releases/overrides/2370012345-payment-service-canary-override.yaml \
  --set image.tag=sha256:abc123def456 --atomic --timeout 10m
```

kevin: ACK. I'll be on-call 17:30-18:30 and will watch latency/error dashboards. If we see a regression, I'll flip the rollback.

jamal: added one small test: please verify payment retry log lines include "retry_attempt" and that downstream queue depth does not spike.

ashley: noted. release-ci: draft note: "Canary config aligned with prod for autoretry flag; image pinned to sha256:abc123def456. Manual verification in eu-west at 17:30 UTC. Rollback plan in runbook."

release-ci: Draft assembled and uploaded to release-notes/drafts/2370012345-fragment.md — tagging @ashley for sign-off.

maria: sign-off from me for manual canary verification. Will post results in this thread after smoke tests. :white_check_mark:

ashley: thanks everyone — proceeding with manual canary per above. If no issues by 18:00 we do a gradual rollout with the same pinned config, otherwise rollback to v2.13.9 as planned.

kevin: copying runbook link: https://wiki/internal/runbooks/helm-rollbacks (will be on hand)

maria: smoke tests passed at 17:43 — no errors, retry logs present, downstream queue stable. Marking as verified. :tada:
